name: Tidal Pelagique
description: Abyssaliste exploitant la pression des profondeurs comme arme défensive contre les agresseurs de surface.

subject.archetype: Tidal Pelagique — Exode pélagique Rare class furtif

loadout.armor_outfit: Organic coral armor grown from living reef material with bioluminescent combat indicators pulsing in rapid rhythm, hydrodynamic fins extending from arms and calves streaming in current, translucent membranes trailing from shoulders with distinctive faction engravings and glowing energy channel conduits running along seams
loadout.arsenal: Bioluminescent harpoon cannon with living coral barrel pulsing with each discharge, hydro-kinetic gauntlets channeling water into pressurized cutting jets visible as focused force streams The weapon and gauntlets actively channel the character's growing ability targeting all_own, visible energy conduits linking weapon to body with flowing power

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist engaged in the heat of battle with weapon and body fully committed to the fight. Arms raised high in commanding gesture with focused targeted energy web radiating outward from chest in all directions, each thread connecting to different allied position across battlefield
attitude.emotion: Lethal intensity — predator recognizing the perfect strike moment

style.rendering_style: cinematic action photography with gritty realism, motion blur on projectiles and debris, sharp focus on character face and primary weapon, high contrast lighting with dramatic deep shadows

palette_names.name: Abyssal Deep Blue
palette_names.role: primary_accent — skin tones and surrounding water mass

palette_names.name: Bioluminescent Cyan
palette_names.role: secondary_accent — ability effects and natural body glow

palette_names.name: Foam White
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — spray splashes and bubble highlights

color_and_light.lighting_setup: cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols running along each border edge, explosive backlight from ability discharge, dramatic rim lighting separating character from environmental chaos, volumetric light rays cutting through smoke and particles

camera.angle: Low dramatic angle emphasizing dominance, wide enough to show full environmental impact of the ability

scenography.setting: Storm-ravaged aquatic colonial battlefield with massive waves crashing over organic structures sending debris flying, lightning illuminating in stark flashes, allied forces pushed back while bioluminescent defensive flares light the water column with cyan bursts
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Complete energy network visible with caster at glowing epicenter, energy flowing outward along dozens of channels simultaneously with each destination growing brighter as power arrives, Battlefield-wide glow connecting all friendly positions in visible network, ground cracking along energy pathways, sky briefly illuminated by massive network flash, Massive waves crashing and spraying bioluminescent droplets everywhere, water vortex spiraling around character pulling debris, glowing fish scattering in panic, bubbles erupting from seabed, electrical arcs flashing through charged seawater
